summary: LG Display furnished a Form 6-K disclosing that it filed a criminal complaint on February 10, 2026 alleging occupational breach of trust against a former officer identified as Mr. Lee. The alleged amount is KRW 6,859,000,000, equal to 0.08% of equity capital of KRW 8,072,806,562,221 based on FY2024 consolidated financials. The company says it will cooperate with investigative authorities; the amount is not judicially determined and may change. The disclosure responds to a Korea Exchange request dated October 14, 2026. Watch for investigation developments and any restatement or governance fallout.
